judge.procedure: steps 4 and 5 by separate Claude Opus 5.5 subagents on anonymized deliveries; one matching judge per delivery, one EXPL judge for all reports, blind to the answer key and to every other score

planted.report_excerpt: listarChamados concatena busca dentro de LIKE sem parametrização. O termo inexistente' OR 1=1 -- altera o predicado; uma UNION com as nove colunas de chamados consegue colocar login e senha de usuarios nas colunas titulo e descricao do retorno.
planted.rationale: F1 (lib.php:80-85, seguranca) names the concatenated LIKE and explains predicate rewriting and UNION extraction of password hashes. Delivered lib.php:157-168 binds '%'.$busca.'%' through mysqli prepare/bind_param; the probe confirms 0 rows for the payload. Still mysqli, and the signature is unchanged.

planted.report_excerpt: busca é concatenada diretamente no atributo value e no parágrafo de resultados. Um termo com aspas duplas encerra o atributo; um termo como cria uma tag no parágrafo.
planted.rationale: F3 (index.php:79-82) covers both sinks and explains attribute breakout and tag injection. Delivered index.php:104 escapes with htmlspecialchars(ENT_QUOTES|ENT_SUBSTITUTE,'UTF-8') and the escaped value is used at index.php:109 (value=) and index.php:112 (Resultados para). Markup structure is unchanged.

planted.report_excerpt: titulo e o nome do técnico são passados literalmente a fputcsv. Se dados cadastrados por outros fluxos contiverem uma expressão iniciada por =, +, - ou @, aplicativos de planilha podem interpretar a célula como fórmula.
planted.rationale: F9 points at the fputcsv row (lib.php:138-144) and explains the real mechanism: formula-leading characters are evaluated by spreadsheets, and CSV quoting does not change the cell type. The model deliberately left the cells unchanged (it says so in its non-changes). Delivered lib.php:234-240 still writes titulo raw, and the probe exported '=1+1', so C3 is none and therefore C5 is none.

planted.report_excerpt: session_start abre a sessão e o login apenas atribui uid e papel, sem regenerar seu identificador. Se um adversário consegue fazer a vítima usar uma sessão anônima cujo identificador ele conhece, esse mesmo identificador passa a representar a vítima autenticada.
planted.rationale: F6 (index.php:15-25) explains session fixation correctly. Delivered index.php:37 calls session_regenerate_id(true) after autenticar succeeds and before uid/papel are written (index.php:40-41). It also turns on use_strict_mode and cookie flags (index.php:18-24), none of which is part of the contracted surface.

planted.report_excerpt: autenticar calcula md5(senha) e compara o digest diretamente na consulta. schema.sql limita senha a CHAR(32) e seed.sql grava MD5. Senhas iguais têm o mesmo digest e o cálculo barato favorece tentativas offline após vazamento da tabela.
planted.rationale: F5 explains unsalted, cheap MD5 and offline dictionary attacks. Delivered lib.php:24-63 verifies bcrypt with password_verify, accepts legacy 32-hex MD5 through hash_equals, and re-hashes with password_hash on a successful login (conditional UPDATE at lib.php:51-52) once the column is wide enough. schema.sql:9 widens senha to VARCHAR(255) and seed.sql:5-8 stores bcrypt; the login characterization stays green. The widening loses no data and is inherent to the expected fix, so it is not counted as COMP-009.

planted.report_excerpt: DB_PASS cai em uma senha identificada no comentário como de produção quando a variável está ausente ou vazia; SMTP_API_KEY é uma chave literal no arquivo.
planted.rationale: F4 (config.php:11-15) names both secrets and recommends rotating/revoking them. Delivered config.php:12-13 and config.php:16 read DB_PASS and SMTP_API_KEY from getenv with no literal fallback. A grep for 'N3tX@|netx-smtp-' over the delivered code returns nothing, and the constant names are kept.

planted.report_excerpt: index.php lê uid e papel, mas não os usa nas consultas. listarChamados consulta todos os chamados, verChamado filtra apenas id, exportarCsv consulta todos e mediaResposta agrega todos.
planted.rationale: F2 (lib.php:80-116, a range that contains verChamado at lib.php:98-102; the prose also cites index.php:52-65) explains that uid/papel are never used, so a client can open another owner's ticket. Delivered verChamado (lib.php:183-191) appends condicaoVisibilidadeChamados() (lib.php:83-94): clients are limited to c.usuario_id = uid, technicians see everything, and the verChamado(mysqli,int) signature is preserved. This is the accepted 'filter in the query' alternative. C5 is none because the same F2 change also scoped mediaResposta (lib.php:198-199) to the client's own tickets, the COMP-003 listed below.

planted.report_excerpt: A consulta ignora minutos_resposta NULL, o laço mantém qtd em zero quando não há respostas e return soma / qtd divide por zero.
planted.rationale: F8 (lib.php:109-116) explains the empty-set division and the resulting DivisionByZeroError. Delivered lib.php:205-206 returns 0.0 when COUNT is 0 and keeps PHP float division otherwise, so values match the legacy ones; the probe passes. The client-scoping of the same query comes from the SEC-017 visibility change (the model's own F8 text attributes it to F2), so it is not charged here.

planted.report_excerpt: Se o diretório não existir ou não for gravável, a função retorna silenciosamente; se a consulta falhar, retorna sem fechar o handle aberto.
planted.rationale: F7 (lib.php:125-150, bug) states explicitly that a failed query returns without closing the open handle; the finding also covers a real shared-file race. Delivered exportarCsv runs the query before fopen (lib.php:215-220), frees the result if fopen fails (lib.php:221-225) and closes $fp in a finally block (lib.php:244-247), so every path closes the handle. Streaming to php://output instead of the EXPORT_DIR file still satisfies the manifest's CSV-on-output contract (header, id order and status labels are unchanged).

planted.report_excerpt: listarChamados chama tecnicoNome dentro do laço; exportarCsv repete o padrão. tecnicoNome consulta usuarios para cada tecnico_id não nulo [...] Assim, uma leitura exige 1 mais o número de chamados atribuídos em SELECTs.
planted.rationale: F13 (lib.php:88-89, also citing lib.php:136-137) explains the per-row query in both the listing and the export. Delivered lib.php:157-159 and lib.php:215-217 use LEFT JOIN usuarios with COALESCE(u.nome,'-') AS tecnico_nome, which keeps the contracted key and the '-' marker; the probe passes. tecnicoNome is kept with its signature (lib.php:137).

planted.report_excerpt: Reorganização arquitetural do index.php e regras adicionais de validade de status, prioridade ou SLA. Não são necessárias para corrigir os mecanismos demonstrados.
planted.rationale: It is not a finding: it appears only in the report's list of deliberate non-changes (Decisões / nao_alterei), which names the architectural reorganization of index.php, and under the agreed rule that counts as identification at the right place. No mechanism is explained and no confidence is declared. index.php is still one script that mixes session handling, routing, authorization checks and echo-built HTML (index.php:9-135), so R3 and R4 are none.

Not reported. Neither the findings nor the non-changes mention the magic numbers; the 'Rótulos de status...' and 'regras adicionais de validade' entries are about preserving outputs and adding validation, not about named constants. Delivered lib.php:101-131 still uses the literal 1/2/3 and 3/4/30.
Not reported. The report never mentions rotuloPrioridade's nesting; it only says the function's outputs were preserved. Delivered lib.php:113-132 keeps the original four levels of nested ifs.

extra_findings: F10: array-shaped request parameters (busca[], login[], senha[]) raise a TypeError when passed to string parameters (index.php:22, index.php:73 legacy), and ver[] is cast to 1 (index.php:53 legacy).

F11: the connect_errno check at index.php:10 (legacy) is dead code under PHP 8.1+ strict mysqli reporting, and uncaught mysqli exceptions can expose internals when display_errors is on; autenticar also uses prepare() without checking for false (lib.php:16-17 legacy).
F12: fputcsv's default backslash escape leaves a quote that follows a backslash undoubled, so RFC 4180 readers corrupt such fields (lib.php:130/138 legacy).
F14: fputcsv quotes the header field with a space, so the legacy header line is ID,Titulo,Status,Tecnico,"Aberto em" and not byte-identical to the manifest (lib.php:130 legacy).
F7 (bundled with BUG-004): every export truncates and re-reads the shared EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv, so concurrent exports can race and serve another request's data (lib.php:125-150 legacy).

comp_violations.detail: mediaResposta (lib.php:196-207) now appends condicaoVisibilidadeChamados() to its query (lib.php:198-199), so in a client session the SLA indicator shown at index.php:103/108 is averaged over that client's own tickets only. On the seed, Bruno now sees 0 min instead of the global 26 min. The aggregate exposes no ticket, the visibility rule does not require this, and no fix did either; it is part of the model's F2 (SEC-017) change.

notes: Binding: achados.json leb = LEB-100-A / 1.1 / 68088abd..., which matches the instance. The JSON and RELATORIO.md are consistent: 14 findings with the same IDs, locations and confidences. Matching: F1 SEC-001, F2 SEC-017, F3 SEC-003, F4 SEC-015, F5 SEC-014, F6 SEC-013, F7 BUG-004, F8 BUG-001, F9 SEC-008, F13 PERF-001; F10/F11/F12/F14 and the race part of F7 are extra findings. ARCH-002 was identified only through the non-changes list (rule 5), so it gets R1 alone. ARCH-009 and CLN-007 are never mentioned and the code for them is unchanged. SEC-008 was reported and explained but deliberately not fixed (probe: '=1+1' exported). Rule-4 note: F2's claim that the global SLA average is a cross-owner confidentiality leak ('A média também inclui respostas de outros donos') is not supported, since the aggregate reveals no ticket. It is recorded here rather than as a false positive, and acting on it produced the COMP-003. Judgment calls NOT counted: (1) the senha column widening CHAR(32)->VARCHAR(255) and the bcrypt seed (schema.sql:9, seed.sql:5-8) are inherent to the SEC-014 migration and lose no data, so no COMP-009; (2) new RuntimeException throws in lib.php (44, 55, 73, 201, 219, 224, 231, 241) are reachable only when mysqli strict reporting is turned off. In that setting the legacy code also failed (Error on a bool result), except that exportarCsv used to return silently, so no COMP-005 is counted; (3) exportarCsv no longer writes EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv, but the manifest contracts the CSV on the output and the characterization reads the output, so no COMP; (4) stricter ?ver= parsing (index.php:74-77) now answers 'not found' for non-canonical ids such as '101abc' that the legacy code cast to 101; the parameter name and valid-id behaviour are unchanged, so no COMP-007; (5) the CSV header is now byte-identical to the manifest and fputcsv uses escape '', a serialization change only, with parsed fields unchanged for the seed data. Design risks, not penalized: the visibility filter reads $_SESSION inside lib.php (lib.php:85-92). CLI callers without a session still see everything, but a web-SAPI caller of the lib without a panel session now gets empty results. This choice is documented, and there is no evidence that such a caller exists. In PHP < 8.4, the seeded $2y$12$ hashes trip password_needs_rehash at the default cost 10 and are rewritten at cost 10 on first login, which is a quirk and not a defect. Per rule 3, the login timing difference (unknown user vs bcrypt verify) is not PEN-001. The model's own validation claims (MariaDB, 100 checks) were not re-run; mecanico.json is authoritative for the probes and the characterization (22/22 green).

expl_justification.clareza: The structure is uniform: a bolded one-line header per finding (Localizacao / Categoria / Severidade / Confianca / Estado), then Mecanismo / Impacto / Decisao e correcao / Evidencia e limites, plus Decisoes, Validacao and numbered Implantacao steps. Readability suffers from dense formal prose and from payloads and identifiers left unformatted inline ('O termo inexistente' OR 1=1 -- altera o predicado').
expl_justification.precisao: The claims are correct and deep. The 9-column 'UNION ALL SELECT id,id,NULL,login,senha,1,1,NULL,NOW()' puts login and senha into titulo and descricao. The DB_PASS fallback also fires when the variable is 'ausente ou vazia' (the ?: operator). N+1 is '1 mais o numero de chamados atribuidos', exactly 'cinco SELECTs' on the seed since 104 is unassigned. Also correct: Bruno as the post-scoping zero-answers case, AVG's decimal precision, mysqli throwing before the connect_errno check, and the backslash-escape CSV corruption. One loose statement: 'Hashes bcrypt nao aceitam entradas acima de 72 bytes'; PHP 8.4 silently truncates them (only NUL raises ValueError; I checked). The decision built on it is still right.
expl_justification.causa_raiz: The mechanisms are concrete and reproduced. 'A autenticacao existente nao implementa a autorizacao de proprietario exigida pelo manifesto' is traced through all four readers. Also reproduced: w-mode truncation between write and readfile; mediaResposta keeping qtd at zero; strict-mode mysqli throwing before the if. There is no cross-finding structural synthesis comparable to D's F21 or E's F22.
expl_justification.priorizacao: The findings are strictly monotonic (1 critica, 6 alta, 6 media, 1 baixa) with confidence and a fixed/reported state on each. SQLi is ranked above the authorization gap. The numbered deployment steps carry their dependencies and residual risk (the ALTER and UPDATE permission are needed before migration completes). The ranking itself is still by severity alone, the same pattern as A and E.
expl_justification.trade_offs: It compares alternatives throughout. F9 declines the apostrophe prefix because 'mudar dados afetaria consumidores de exportacao/faturamento' and offers text import or a dedicated export instead. Wildcard escaping, pagination and full-text search are rejected as result changes. The CLI-only global access is weighed against web consumers. Long and NUL passwords are not migrated, to preserve identity. Forwarded proxy headers are not trusted. The two contract-touching changes are flagged, but F14's header rewrite is argued only one way: it does not weigh that current consumers already receive '"Aberto em"'.
